paragraphs: GATX Corporation ("GATX," the "Company," "we," "us," "our," and similar terms), a New York corporation founded in 1898, is a leading global railcar lessor, owning fleets in North America, Europe, and India. In addition, through GATX Engine Leasing ("GEL"), our wholly owned aircraft spare engine leasing business, and our joint ventures with Rolls-Royce plc (or affiliates thereof, collectively "Rolls-Royce"), we own one of the largest aircraft spare engine lease portfolios in the world. We report our financial results through three primary business segments: Rail North America, Rail International, and Engine Leasing. Financial results for our tank container leasing business ("Trifleet") are reported in the Other segment.

On May 29, 2025, GATX entered into a definitive agreement to acquire railcars from Wells Fargo Bank, N.A. ("Wells Fargo") through a newly formed joint venture ("GABX" or the "GABX joint venture") with Brookfield Infrastructure Partners L.P. and its institutional partners (collectively, "Brookfield"). The transaction formally closed on January 1, 2026 and consisted of approximately 101,000 railcars for approximately $4.2 billion. Initially, GATX's ownership share of GABX is 30%, with Brookfield's share at 70%. GATX will have the option to acquire up to 100% of GABX's equity over time. GATX also agreed to directly purchase approximately 200 locomotives from Wells Fargo for approximately $30.4 million, and Brookfield agreed to directly acquire Wells Fargo's rail finance lease portfolio. GATX will serve as manager of the railcars in GABX as well as the finance lease portfolio directly owned by Brookfield. In anticipation of the closing of the transaction, on December 31, 2025, GATX contributed equity of $385.3 million to GABX, Brookfield contributed equity of $899.0 million to GABX, and GABX executed a $2.96 billion term loan to fund the acquisition. GATX has guaranteed GABX's debt financing obligations. During 2025, GABX entered into deal contingent interest rate swaps in order to hedge the exposure on its anticipated debt financing. As of December 31, 2025, GABX is consolidated and is reported in the Rail North America segment, and its operations will be reflected within that segment for reporting periods after the closing of the transaction. See "Note 26. Subsequent Events" in Part II, Item 8 of this Form 10-K for further information.
In the fourth quarter of 2025, GATX Rail Europe acquired 5,882 railcars from DB Cargo AG.

We depend on continued demand from our customers to lease or use our transportation assets and services at satisfactory rates. A significant decline in customer demand could negatively impact our business and financial performance.

Our profitability depends on our ability to lease assets at satisfactory rates and to re-lease assets upon lease expiration. Customer demand for our transportation assets and services can be adversely affected by various economic and other factors, including:

•Weak macroeconomic conditions and world trade policies, including threatened or implemented tariffs, embargoes and sanctions;
•Weak market conditions in our customers' businesses; •Adverse changes in the price of, or demand for, commodities;

paragraphs: 以下對 GATX Corporation ("GATX", "本公司," "我們," "我們," "我們," 及類似用語) 財務狀況及營運成果的討論與分析，應與本 Form 10-K 中 "第 8 項 財務報表及補充資料" 所載的審計財務報表一併閱讀。我們基於以下討論與分析，係根據美國通用會計準則 ("GAAP") 製作的財務報表所衍生的財務資料，以及我們使用非 GAAP 組件所製作的其他財務資料。有關這些非 GAAP 指標與最相近 GAAP 指標的轉換說明，請參閱本項末尾的 "非 GAAP 財務指標"。本討論未包含 2024 年與 2023 年財務結果的比較，此比較可於我們 2024 年 12 月 31 日為期末的年度報告 Form 10-K 中 "第 II 項 管理層對財務狀況及營運成果之討論與分析" 找到，該報告於 2025 年 2 月 19 日向 SEC 提交。
我們租賃、營運、管理及重新行銷長期使用且廣泛使用的資產，主要在鐵路市場。我們透過三個主要業務分部報告財務結果：北美鐵路、國際鐵路及引擎租賃。我們的液壓容器租賃業務 ("Trifleet") 財務結果則列於其他分部。

於 2025 年 5 月 29 日，GATX 與 Wells Fargo Bank, N.A.（"Wells Fargo"）簽訂最終協議，透過新成立的合資公司（"GABX" 或 "GABX 合資公司"）取得約 101,000 臺鐵車，合資公司由 Brookfield Infrastructure Partners L.P. 及其機構夥伴（合稱 "Brookfield"）共同成立。此交易於 2026 年 1 月 1 日正式完成，交易內容為約 101,000 臺鐵車，總金額約 4.2 十億美元。初期，GATX 在 GABX 的持股為 30%，Brookfield 的持股為 70%。GATX 有權在未來逐步取得 GABX 全部股權。GATX 同時同意直接購買約 200 臺機車，總金額約 30.4 百萬美元，Brookfield 同意直接取得 Wells Fargo 的鐵路融資租賃資產組合。GATX 將擔任 GABX 所有鐵車及 Brookfield 直接擁有融資租賃資產組合的管理公司。為預備交易完成，於 2025 年 12 月 31 日，GATX 向 GABX 貢獻 equity 約 385.3 百萬美元，Brookfield 向 GABX 貢獻 equity 約 899.0 百萬美元，GABX 並執行 2.96 十億美元的長期貸款以資助此次收購。GATX 已為 GABX 的債務融資義務提供擔保。於 2025 年，GABX 籤訂了與交易預期債務融資相關的利率期貨合約，以對沖其債務融資的風險。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，GABX 已納入合併財務報表，並歸屬於 Rail North America 分部，其營運將於交易完成後的會計期間反映於該分部。有關進一步資訊，請參閱本 Form 10-K 第二部分，第 8 項 "Note 26. Subsequent Events"。
2025 年第四季，GATX Rail Europe 從 DB Cargo AG 收購 5,882 臺鐵路車輛。此次收購為擴大並多元化 GRE 軍隊的機會，透過加入多種有利的車型組合。
2023 年，我們出售了俄羅斯的鐵路業務 ("Rail Russia")。此交易對我們的營運並無重大影響。
2023 年，我們出售了引擎租賃分部內剩餘的三艘液化氣運輸船 ("Specialized Gas Vessels")。

paragraphs: 投資人應考量下列風險因素，以及本檔或其他檔中所包含的其他資訊，作為投資本公司證券之參考。若下列風險因素中所述任何事件發生，將可能對本公司之業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大不利影響。
我們依賴客戶持續租賃或使用我們之運輸資產與服務，且租金需達合理水準。若客戶需求大幅下降，將可能對我們之業務與財務表現造成負面影響。
我們之獲利能力取決於我們能否以合理租金出租資產，並在租賃到期後重新出租。客戶對我們運輸資產與服務之需求可能因各種經濟及其他因素而受到不利影響，包括：
• 長時間通貨膨脹或通貨緊縮；• 高利率；
• 不利之總體經濟條件與世界貿易政策，包括威脅或已實施之關稅、禁運與制裁；
• 客戶業務之市場條件不佳；• 商品價格或需求之不利變動；
